# rauthy_auth_provider (Data Source)

Auth Provider data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rauthy_auth_provider" "google" {
  id = "google"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Provider ID

### Optional

- `admin_claim_path` (String) Admin Claim Path
- `admin_claim_value` (String) Admin Claim Value
- `jwks_endpoint` (String) JWKS Endpoint
- `mfa_claim_path` (String) MFA Claim Path
- `mfa_claim_value` (String) MFA Claim Value

### Read-Only

- `authorization_endpoint` (String) Authorization Endpoint
- `auto_link` (Boolean) Auto Link
- `auto_onboarding` (Boolean) Auto Onboarding
- `client_id` (String) Client ID
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Secret
- `client_secret_basic` (Boolean) Client Secret Basic
- `client_secret_post` (Boolean) Client Secret Post
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled
- `issuer` (String) Provider Issuer
- `name` (String) Provider Name
- `scope` (String) Scope
- `token_endpoint` (String) Token Endpoint
- `typ` (String) Type
- `use_pkce` (Boolean) Use PKCE
- `userinfo_endpoint` (String) Userinfo Endpoint
